offering_description.value: Provides leadership, productivity, trust, sales and customer-loyalty training content and consulting to organizations. Delivers it through subscription access to its content library, live and virtual facilitation by certified facilitators and its own consultants, and related books and assessments.

primary_products.value: training content and courseware; leadership books and publications; assessments

primary_services.value: leadership and professional skills training; consulting; facilitator certification; virtual and on-site workshops

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporations, training departments, and organizations of all sizes; B2G: government agencies and public-sector organizations; B2C: individuals buying books and development resources

end_markets.value: corporate training; professional development; education; government; sales and customer service

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual subscriptions to training content library and licensed access; service fees: facilitated workshops, coaching and consulting engagements; product sales: books, assessments and training materials; licensing or royalties: licensed content and international licensee partners
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; product sales; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: develops training content and delivers consulting and facilitation to organizations; software / platform: digital subscription platform for training content delivered to client organizations; brand owner: owns content intellectual property licensed to partners and facilitators
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; brand owner

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific via direct offices and licensee partners in many countries

specialization.value: related lines: leadership, productivity, trust, sales performance and customer loyalty training content and services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to enterprise and organizational clients; partners / resellers: international licensee partners and certified facilitators; online: digital platform and website sales of subscriptions and books

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business, data privacy and consumer rules apply, no special licensing
